text: F1S: hardware_due misfires on scar3 — root cause. _skill/engines/f1s_live.py:293 hardware_due() only checks seat==curator; on scar3 _registry/machine.json local_curator=ai_scar3, so the darkhero-only HW_RING D:\__hwlog (line 61) is judged stale ('no segment at all') every 30 min. scar3 has no D: drive and no ai_darkhero/tray. Fix proposal: also require the logger host (e.g. machine.json hostname=='darkhero' or HW_RING.parent drive exists) before alerting. Not edited locally to avoid package divergence.
